_about: SINGLE-TRANSLATION SHELF: a second shelf of one-off translations of science, medicine, art history and the crafts: Carnot's Reflections on the Motive Power of Heat (Thurston), Huygens's Celestial Worlds Discover'd (1698), Pasteur's Studies on Fermentation, Sachs's History of Botany, Helmholtz's Popular Lectures, Metchnikoff's Immunity, Behring, Hansen on leprosy, Bichat on mucous membranes (Houlton), Desault on fractures, Marie Curie's Pierre Curie, Arrhenius's Worlds in the Making, Holst and Kramers on the Bohr atom, Warming's botany, Huber's ants, Fabre's Insect Life (Margaret Roberts), Bergman's mineralogy (Withering), Glauber and Sendivogius on alchemy, Chevreul on colour, Cellini's treatises on goldsmithing and sculpture (Ashbee), Vasari on technique, Koldewey's Excavations at Babylon, Rodin on art, Robert-Houdin's Secrets of Stage Conjuring, Groos's Play of Man, Mosso's Fear, Ritter's Comparative Geography, Flammarion, and handbooks on lithography, pigments, perfumes, horseshoeing, bees, music, warfare and engines. Newton's Principia (Motte) and Menabrea's Sketch of the Analytical Engine with Ada Lovelace's Notes wait in _pending: Gutenberg has them only as HTML. Each title gates on its own translator (_surname_by_slug). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 46); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
